node_fixture.name: p8test_desktop_login
header: # Node fixture `p8test_desktop_login` for mount_shares_desktop on the GNOME node (kind gnome). It replaces the stand-in
# `p8test_desktop_home` (HQ after batch 20, item 6: the lift "the desktop login"). The define writes its two scripts into
# /home/<username>/Desktop (mount_shares_desktop.pp:7-8) and never declares it: on a desktop the user's first graphical
# login creates ~/Desktop (xdg-user-dirs, started by the session). Here that login happens for real: the fixture
# declares the test user p8testuser (never a real account) and logs it in to GNOME once through GDM's automatic login,
# then waits until the session has created ~/Desktop. The directory is not declared: it is the login's.
# Runs only while ~/Desktop is absent, and before the define's files.
# Lifted by: nothing needed — a test asset (rules/test_asset_fixtures.txt): ~/Desktop comes from a real first login.
resources: exec[p8test first desktop login of p8testuser]
node_fixture.scope_evidence: p8test_desktop_login (listed in rules/test_asset_fixtures.txt as a test asset, no mock-apply marker): user[p8testuser] is the fixture test identity (not a real account) that owns the home the define writes into; file[/usr/local/sbin/p8test-first-desktop-login] is a script that temporarily sets GDM AutomaticLogin=p8testuser in /etc/gdm3/custom.conf, restarts gdm3, waits up to 180s for the session to create /home/p8testuser/Desktop, then restores the original custom.conf; exec[p8test first desktop login of p8testuser] runs it only while ~/Desktop is absent (creates guard) and is ordered before the define. None of these declares or alters the define's two file resources or ~/Desktop itself (it comes from the real login); all stay within the stated asset: the test user plus one real first GNOME login
